items.html: *And we will explain the matter of the worlds of BYA themselves — what was their discernment. Know that there is nothing that does not have internality and externality, even in the aspect of the vessels, as was stated above. And indeed, from half of the Tifferet and the NHY of Adam Kadmon until the end of his feet, their externality divides into two discernments: and behold, their externality from the side of the face is what is called Beriah, and that from the side of the back is called Yetzirah.
